output.summary: Most of Arts' slower resolution comes from SlotBook tickets routed by RR-17 to the unstaffed P4 queue, which closes about 70% of the gap. Matched non-SlotBook Arts tickets resolve at near-university speed except on-site hardware, where Lindqvist's Tuesday/Thursday coverage also slows Education. Arts volume is only partly explained by SlotBook, and duplicate rates match the university. Arts staff were not told their tickets had no target, and the auto-acknowledgement is generic. Whether ITS told Arts leadership of RR-17 in August 2025 remains unknown. The SSO link to the SlotBook rise is contradicted by timing and mechanism. Transferring 2 FTE and moving all Arts tickets to P4 are harmful; agreeing SlotBook support and fixing the acknowledgement is preferred.
